issue.title: Pager history PNG goldens intermittently render without history chrome (pill, version strip, history footer)

task_type_fields.evidence: At master ba91bf93c1, serial repeats of the 32-param file (sase-1eu.land, 2026-10-03) failed exactly one param in 3 of 4 runs, a different param each time: past-frame-False-size1, dirty-False-size0 and tombstone-True-size1; earlier runs also hit tombstone-True-size0 and dirty-True-size1. The failing frame is missing all history chrome: no DELETED/version pill or age chip, no version strip, and the footer reads 'E edit now · / search · ? keys · q close' instead of '( v2 · = diff · @ timeline · E edit now ...'. That is 26k-91k changed px. It predates epic sase-1eu: a worktree at 5dff14eab4~1 (before the epic's pager port) failed 2 of 4 runs (past-frame-True-size0, tombstone-False-size1 twice). c62e4f1491 passed 4 of 4, which suggests a timing race rather than a code change. Likely a capture-before-history-load race; compare sase-1et (time-band base-style race).

issue.creation_reason: Found by sase-1eu.land while checking epic sase-1eu's pager goldens: one random history golden param fails in most runs, the flake predates the epic, and no bead tracks it.

payload.description: sibling pager visual-golden race in the time-band suite; a shared capture barrier may fix both
both make pager history/time-band PNG goldens red on master; fix together when regenerating goldens
